capture_source: origin/main 3db2d1965eceef0265ab3ffe3007cb83dbc1f74b on iPhone 17 / iOS 26.5 simulator with deterministic Map fixtures
state_server_capture: unavailable: this repository intentionally has no DebugBridge or GET /state/snapshot integration; the fixture records the exact launch state and source contract instead
reported_problem: new Map annotations mount with isVisible already true, so MapPinEntranceModifier renders them at their final scale and offset and its value-driven animation never receives a false-to-true transition
expected_behavior: newly mounted saved and search pins start at the hidden scale and vertical offset, then spring to their presented state with stagger when Reduce Motion is off; Reduce Motion presents them immediately
performance_contract: entrance state is local to each mounted pin, changes only on mount or isVisible/reduceMotion changes, and never publishes camera-frame state or rebuilds the annotation collection per frame
selected_pin_contract: the independent selected-pin reselection bounce remains unchanged
